Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Product Designer position at Monzo. Although my background began in the hospitality sector, I have spent the last two years developing a passion for design and product thinking. While working as a barista, I honed my ability to observe user needs, manage complex workflows, and deliver consistent, high‑quality service—skills that translate directly to product design.

Driven by curiosity, I taught myself Figma and created an AI‑powered app that streamlines coffee‑ordering experiences by predicting user preferences. This project sharpened my skills in wireframing, prototyping, and iterative testing, and it reinforced my belief that thoughtful design can make everyday tasks effortless.

At Monzo, I am eager to bring my blend of frontline user empathy, self‑paced learning, and data‑driven design to help build intuitive, delightful banking experiences. I look forward to discussing how my unique journey can contribute to Monzo’s mission of redefining the way people manage money.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
